journal_lines: Pillager patrol. Took the long way around. Then didn't.
Outpost nearby. Picked off the one that wandered.
Better armed than expected. Still manageable.
The patrol was four, not two. Narrowed the path.
Outpost nearby. Went around and then back.
Took the one on the ridge first.
They had a banner. Territory claim. Contested it.
Two bolts before I closed the gap.
The captain had an ominous feeling. Also a crossbow. Managed both.
They patrol in a circuit. Waited for the gap.
One straggler behind the group. Started there.
Followed at a distance. They turned. Engaged.
Outpost scouts. Picked them off before they could signal back.
Raider on a ravager. Different scale of problem. Still manageable.
